en_title: Captain Price Actor Barry Sloane Says He's the Most Qualified Person to Star in the Call of Duty Movie
cn_title: 普莱斯队长扮演者巴里·斯隆称自己是出演《使命召唤》电影的最合适人选
opus_summary: 普莱斯队长的扮演者Barry Sloane表示，希望在《使命召唤》真人电影中继续饰演这一角色，并认为自己是最有资格的人。他感谢粉丝的支持，同时指出选角仍需经过片方的流程。影片预计以《现代战争》系列的世界观为背景，定于2028年上映。

paragraphs.en: Captain Price actor Barry Sloane wants to be in the Call of Duty movie and believes he's the most qualified person for the job.
paragraphs.cn: 普莱斯队长的扮演者巴里·斯隆希望出演《使命召唤》电影，并认为自己是这一工作的最合适人选。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with Dan Allen Gaming , Sloane was asked if he's interested in reprising his role as Price in the upcoming live-action Call of Duty film. The movie, directed by Peter Berg and written by Taylor Sheridan, is expected to be set in the Modern Warfare universe , but it's unclear if it's a new story or a direct adaptation of one of the games. With that said, it's hard to imagine a Modern Warfare movie without Price. Sloane wants in on the film and even went as far as to say he's the most qualified person on the planet to do it.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受Dan Allen Gaming采访时，斯隆被问及是否有兴趣在即将推出的《使命召唤》真人电影中再次饰演普莱斯。这部由彼得·博格执导、泰勒·谢里丹编剧的电影预计以《现代战争》宇宙为背景，但目前尚不清楚它会讲述一个新故事，还是直接改编自其中一部游戏。话虽如此，很难想象一部没有普莱斯的《现代战争》电影。斯隆希望参演这部电影，甚至表示自己是地球上最适合出演的人。

paragraphs.en: "I don't think there's anyone else on the planet who is as qualified for the job as I am," said Sloane. "Who has lived the character for almost a decade? Who understands the size of the projects, the love of that fan base, and has been on the journey with them from the get-go? Hollywood is a beast. Sometimes things are decided for certain reasons that can never be understood. But if you're asking me, would I like to do it? Absolutely, I would love to play him in a movie. 100%. That would be fantastic. But let's let the Hollywood cards fall where they land."
paragraphs.cn: 「我认为地球上没有其他人像我一样适合这份工作。」斯隆说，「谁像我一样在近十年里一直扮演这个角色？谁了解这些项目的规模、粉丝群体对它的热爱，并从一开始就与他们一同走过这段旅程？好莱坞是个庞然大物。有时事情会因为某些永远无法理解的原因而被决定。但如果你问我愿不愿意做？当然，我非常愿意在电影中扮演他。百分之百愿意。那会很棒。不过，就让好莱坞的事情顺其自然吧。」

paragraphs.en: Sloane also noted that there's been a vocal outpouring from fans to have him play Price in the film, which he massively appreciates. He noted that typically, there's a group of names that a studio wants for a role like this, and they have to go through that process themselves. Nevertheless, he believes he'd be an "asset" to the production if he were to have the opportunity.
paragraphs.cn: 斯隆还提到，粉丝们纷纷发声，希望他在电影中饰演普莱斯，他对此非常感激。他指出，通常情况下，电影公司对于这样的角色会有一批心仪的人选，他们必须自行走完这一流程。尽管如此，他认为如果有机会参演，自己会成为这部电影制作的「助力」。

paragraphs.en: As games have gotten increasingly realistic, they've also started to use the likenesses of the actors who play them. This has led to demand from fans that film adaptations should use the actors from the games. Of course, Hollywood might make the argument that they're not as big of a box office draw compared to a more traditional mainstream movie star. Whether Call of Duty will utilize the game's cast remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 随着游戏变得越来越写实，游戏也开始使用扮演角色的演员的相貌。这使得粉丝们要求电影改编作品使用游戏中的演员。当然，好莱坞可能会认为，与更传统的主流电影明星相比，这些演员的票房号召力没有那么大。《使命召唤》是否会采用游戏的演员阵容，还有待观察。

paragraphs.en: Spoilers for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 follow below .
paragraphs.cn: 以下内容涉及《使命召唤：现代战争4》剧透。

paragraphs.en: Of course, if the Call of Duty movie is canonical to the games, where it falls in the timeline will dictate what characters can show up. Modern Warfare 4 brutally takes a number of characters off the board, including Captain Price. At the end of the game, the character is left to bleed out in the middle of the wilderness, with Ghost having said his goodbyes to his fallen leader. It's a tragic ending for the character, but one that felt right and leaves the future of the Modern Warfare games in question .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，如果《使命召唤》电影属于游戏正史，它在时间线上的位置将决定哪些角色能够登场。《现代战争4》残酷地让多名角色退场，其中包括普莱斯队长。在游戏结尾，幽灵向倒下的领队告别后，普莱斯被留在荒野之中，直至失血而亡。这是该角色的悲剧结局，但让人觉得恰如其分，也让《现代战争》系列游戏的未来充满疑问。

paragraphs.en: With that said, if the Call of Duty movie takes place within the canon, it would have to be set before Modern Warfare 4. If it's a sequel of sorts, it may focus on all-new characters or the surviving ones like Ghost and the Korean characters introduced in MW4. The film is due out in 2028, so we'll likely hear more on casting sometime next year as filming nears.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，如果《使命召唤》电影发生在正史之中，它的故事就必须设定在《现代战争4》之前。如果它算是某种形式的续作，那么它可能会聚焦全新角色，或幽灵以及《现代战争4》中登场的韩国角色等幸存人物。影片定于2028年上映，因此随着开拍临近，我们很可能会在明年某个时候听到更多选角消息。
